steps.trigger: JMA issues typhoon outlook or 早期注意情報 for 長野県
steps.headline: Watch phase: remote family activates monitoring, Yoshiko begins preparation

actions.description: Check JMA typhoon track; if Nagano is in the forecast cone, call Yoshiko and say slowly: 「台風が来るかもしれません。準備を始めてください」
Contact the pre-arranged support helper to confirm availability for this event
Move go-bag to front entrance; confirm all medications are packed; charge mobile phone to 100%
Check that 長野市 disaster alert SMS/automated-call service is active for Yoshiko's phone (no app needed); review this timeline

steps.trigger: 大雨注意報・洪水注意報 OR 氾濫注意情報 issued for 長野市
steps.headline: Elevated watch: confirm helper commitment, check river level, finish supplies

actions.description: Call Yoshiko to confirm she has received the alert and her go-bag is ready; confirm exact time the helper will arrive at her door
Check Chikuma River level at the 国土交通省 川の防災情報 site (www.river.go.jp); if already above 氾濫注意水位, skip Level 3 and escalate immediately
Fill all water bottles; lay out sturdy shoes and raincoat by the front door; eat a proper meal
Send Yoshiko a plain-text SMS reminder: 「明日、〇〇さんと一緒に北部スポーツ・レクリエーションパークへ避難してください」

steps.trigger: 長野市 発令: 高齢者等避難 (Level 3) OR 氾濫警戒情報 OR 大雨警報
steps.headline: Yoshiko departs NOW with helper — mobility needs mean Level 3 is her evacuation trigger, not a preparation signal

actions.description: Immediately call Yoshiko AND the helper to confirm both are moving; ask the single critical question: 「今、〇〇さんの家にいますか？一緒に出発しましたか？」 — do not hang up until confirmed

Arrive at Yoshiko's home and depart together on foot toward 北部スポーツ・レクリエーションパーク (長野県長野市大字三才1981-1, approximately 2.63 km west). Allow 90–120 minutes walking time. Do NOT go to 穂保高台避難公園 or 長沼小学校 — neither is flood-designated and both may flood.
Pick up go-bag, lock door, depart with helper. On arrival, call Kenji immediately: 「着きました」
If the helper cannot come, immediately call 長野市 の地域支え合いセンターまたは 119 to request evacuation assistance — do not leave Yoshiko to walk alone

steps.trigger: 避難指示 OR 氾濫危険情報 issued for 穂保 — OR — 大雨特別警報 announced while horizontal evacuation is still physically possible (complete the journey to shelter before stopping; once Level 5 氾濫発生情報 is issued, movement may no longer be safe)
steps.headline: Complete evacuation to shelter — this level means the river is about to overflow; Yoshiko must already be at the shelter

actions.description: Confirm Yoshiko has arrived at 北部スポーツ・レクリエーションパーク; if she has NOT yet left home, call 119 immediately and stay on the line — the 2-storey house will be fully submerged at statutory flood depth (10–20 m) and upper floors are NOT a refuge
If Kenji cannot reach Yoshiko, Mika calls 119 and provides the address 長野県長野市穂保, describing that an elderly woman with limited mobility may need rescue

If still en route: keep moving toward the shelter with the helper; if water is already blocking the route, stop, call 119, move to the highest accessible indoor point as a last resort only — understand that the building will not be tall enough at maximum flood depth

steps.trigger: 氾濫発生情報 OR 長野市 発令 緊急安全確保 — flooding is occurring now
steps.headline: Do not move outdoors — protect life where you are; emergency rescue may be the only option

actions.description: Do NOT go outside. Move to the highest reachable indoor position. Open a window or door to signal rescuers. Call 119 if not already done.
Remain in phone contact with Yoshiko; relay her exact location (長野県長野市穂保 の自宅) to 119; do not end the call
If Kenji cannot reach Yoshiko or 119, Mika attempts contact and coordinates with emergency services from her location

supply_checklist: 処方薬（最低7日分）と服薬スケジュールのメモ
保険証・マイナンバーカードのコピー
現金（小銭含む、ATM不使用を想定）
飲料水 3日分（Yoshiko 1人分：約6リットル）
非常食 3日分（食べやすいもの、調理不要）
携帯電話 と 充電ケーブル・モバイルバッテリー
歩きやすい靴・レインコート・着替え2日分
タオル・ウェットティッシュ・マスク
簡易トイレ・生理衛生用品
避難カード（住所・連絡先・避難先を印刷したもの）
杖または歩行補助器（Yoshiko の膝の状態に応じて）
毛布または保温シート
